synergy_long_term_harness feature branches: append-only content-addressed chunk archive, bounded context assembly, durable mission state, idempotency, lease fencing and local capability bridge
gaps: No shared canonical record schema across hierarchical MemoryRecord, Long-Term Harness chunk-manifest MemoryStore and synergy.semantic-memory-record/v1.
No namespace-safe cross-repository source identity contract
Repository ingestion lacks explicit symlink rejection
No cross-repository E2E execution and independent evidence receipt
No typed boundary yet separates semantic retrieval/context planning from immutable source archive and mission-state lifecycle.
uncontracted_components.next_gate: Define one versioned memory subsystem contract with separate record/archive and retrieval/context operations; assign authority and trust; bind immutable source identities; add authenticated adapters and cross-repository E2E tests. Keep mission lifecycle and semantic indexing as separate bounded capabilities.

observed_related_work: synergy_agi_autopilot PR #12/#13/#14/#18/#21/#24: TaskStore, policy decisions, approvals, single-winner execution claims, idempotent replay and uncertain-state fencing
synergy_long_term_harness PR #1-#4: MissionStore, company-scoped idempotency, epoch/worker leases, stale-lease fencing, result digests and independent signed verification receipts
gaps: No canonical shared task/mission state machine or versioned lifecycle event schema
Idempotency-key scope and replay fingerprint semantics differ between TaskStore and MissionStore
Autopilot uses conditional single-winner execution claims; Long-Term Harness uses worker/epoch leases and stale-lease fencing; no common lease protocol
Independent verification receipt and HMAC signer identity exist in Long-Term Harness but are not a shared Autopilot contract
No cross-repository crash/retry/uncertain-outcome reconciliation or E2E evidence
uncontracted_components.next_gate: Define a shared mission lifecycle protocol for identity, idempotency, state transitions, events, lease epochs, uncertain outcomes, result digests and independent verification. Keep product-specific policy, capabilities and execution authority local to each repository. Add exact-head cross-repository retry/fencing tests before registering a runtime edge.

findings: Main API settlement path does not invoke the settlement evidence adapter and reconciliation engine before terminal settlement.
Actual received amount can diverge from planned route output; audit also identifies zero-as-missing fallback to planned amount.
Provider result status is not constrained to a terminal-success allowlist before ledger posting.
Accounting-recognition payload can be constructed without a resolved, independently reconciled settlement payload.
Pay System settlement evidence v1 is not directly interchangeable with the Financial OS canonical settlement receipt v2 without an explicit verified adapter.
Webhook acknowledgement, live coordinator and main settlement route are not yet one canonical durable lifecycle.
observed_contract_risks.ci_evidence: AUDIT_DOCUMENT_ONLY; PR#24 changes one audit document and does not implement remediation; no source tests or provider E2E were run by that PR.
observed_contract_risks.next_gate: One canonical flow must bind provider transaction/finality evidence, actual fills, independent reconciliation, balanced ledger posting, durable outbox and Financial OS recognition. Add negative tests for pending/partial/zero/duplicate/mismatched receipts and exact-head E2E.

findings: AccountingTransactionalOutbox validates event_bytes against a caller-supplied SHA-256 digest; the inspected outbox method does not itself verify a cryptographic signature or signer identity. Hash integrity is not signature authenticity.

The SQLite connection is shared with check_same_thread=False; transaction() has no explicit per-connection mutex. Concurrent transaction callers need dedicated serialization tests or separate connections.
observed_contract_risks.ci_evidence: PR#39 workflow job failed with steps=null; no tests are attested as executed.
observed_contract_risks.next_gate: Bind event authenticity to a verifier/key policy and explicit signer identity; test concurrent writers, crash recovery, idempotent replay, outbox publication and cross-repository consumer verification.

findings: Prior V4 report recognized modeled bridge volume and inferred AMM fee estimates as external revenue without transaction-level receipts; those reported fee figures are superseded.
PR#10 separates modeled fee estimates from HardNAV and adds a fail-closed verified-receipt path with durable SQLite journal and replay/tamper tests.
The injected receipt verifier is still an external trust boundary; it is not itself a production chain verifier.
The corrected 13,000-block replay and new return/drawdown report are explicitly pending; no corrected performance number is claimed.
